name: stats-details
title: Detailed Stats Cards
description: A row of three black stat cards, each with a small icon, a short label, a large figure and a couple of lines of explanation. Hovering one fills it with a hot pink photograph and turns the text white.
use: A product or landing page wants three explained metrics with a dramatic photo reveal on hover.
avoid: All three cards share one unrelated abstract photo, and every value and caption is fixed in the file.
a11y: All text is readable without hovering, but the hover image has a meaningless alt and the transitions ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three near-black rounded cards in a row on a black page, divided by faint borders. Each starts with a small outlined square icon, a tiny uppercase grey label, a large pale figure and two lines of small grey text. A hovered card is flooded with a pink-to-red abstract photo and an orange icon tile.
behaves: Hovering a card fades a colourful image in behind the text, warms its border to orange, fills the icon square and lifts the label and description to white. Leaving cross-fades everything back to the flat dark card.
customise: The three metrics, their notes and the one shared hover image are hardcoded; border, icon and overlay colours need source edits.
weight: light: Three static cards with CSS hover transitions and no running animation.
demo: Revenue Growth +142%, Customer Retention 94%, Data Processed 14PB, each with a one-sentence note.
issues: Idle descriptions are very small and dim on the near-black cards.
The same abstract pink photo is used for every card regardless of the metric.
polishWhy: Clean card row and a punchy hover reveal; the idle text is faint and the cards look ordinary.
